title: AppReleaseV1
description: The record of one application release (#11), stored at releases/app/<release>/release.json next to its renderer artifact and never rewritten: the renderer module and HTML template a content release renders with, and every hashed asset under assets/ the rendered HTML may reference, each with its digest. A content publish resolves the deployed release from /current.json, verifies this record's digest, then every renderer file and the presence of every asset, before it renders anything.

release.description: The commit of redact-secret-www this release was built from (after CI passed on it).

renderer.description: The renderer module, relative to the release root (releases/app/<release>/).

template.description: The HTML template, relative to the release root.

files.description: The renderer artifact's files, relative to the release root.

assets.description: Every hashed asset of the release, bucket-relative (assets/…).
